messages:
Nina P.: quick design spike 11 working on the Deployments timeline: two surface questions - how explicit should we be about canary percentages in the row vs details, and what's the safest default for rollback CTAs?

Omar H.: in user tests people wanted the percent visible at-a-glance. Suggest small pill: "10%" next to the status chip. Keep the full chart in details.

Jules K.: agree on percent pill. For rollover/hover, show exact timestamp + who initiated. But avoid screen reader noise - collapsed rows should read: "Version: release-2026-04-15, canary 10%" not long lists of metadata.

Priya L.: a11y note: collapse sha/author behind an explicit "More info" button with aria-expanded. That prevents long automatic reads. Also prefer aria-live polite for percentage changes, debounced 1.5s.

Nina P.: rollback wording: PMs dislike just "Revert" because it's ambiguous. Options: "Start rollback", "Rollback (gradual)", "Force rollback (all traffic)". We should bias the primary action toward gradual.

Omar H.: primary = "Start rollback" (which opens modal with gradual option preselected). Secondary red = "Force rollback" behind an extra confirm input. Keyboard accessible of course.

Jules K.: tiny UI nit: when timeline is compact, the action buttons collapse into an overflow menu. Make sure the keyboard focus order still exposes rollback as a first menu item and the menu is labelled "Version actions".

deploy-bot: event: rollout 2099 -> canary 10% at 2187654355 UTC

Priya L.: copy suggestion for live announcements: say "Canary reached 10% traffic for release-2026-04-15" rather than just "status changed". localize strings.

Nina P.: great. I'll mock the compact row with the percent pill, updated aria patterns, and the rollback modal flows. Jules/Priya please review SR+keyboard flows once I have a prototype.

Omar H.: I'll add the confirm-input pattern for force rollback to the spec.

Jules K.: will review, focusing on focus order and menu labels.

Priya L.: I'll run quick NVDA pass when proto is ready.

Nina P.: thanks all 60a0 I'll file the ticket and attach the mock. :white_check_mark:
